Before any code

  1. Jurisdiction and sanction — confirm the school and that the product is school-authorised, not independent.
  2. Chat model — accept the tiered, disclosed-monitoring model in ADR-0005 or choose another explicitly.
  3. Counsel review — the ten questions in the DPIA: the under-16 carve-outs, monitored chat, retention, and cross-border AI.

The plan is gated on purpose: no chat, no compute and no economy until those are settled in writing.
